title: Grinder works well, peppercorns in a mid-courseness came out even and well ground
text: Grinder works well, peppercorns in a mid-courseness came out even and well ground. I have had several electronic salt and pepper shakers over the years. Overall they disappoint me and typically I revert back to the manual grinding ones. This  Cole & Mason Penrose peppermill is no exception. First, I couldn't get it open (even after reading the instructions several times). Granted, I am a 62 year old female and eventually asked my son to help. He struggled but eventually got it open. Then came the batteries (6? Isn't that crazy?). I used this for black peppercorns. It did grind well, and there were adjustable settings depending on how you like your courseness. Anyway, not much to say. It is a good mill, not sure how long the 6 batteries will last. If it turns out less than a month I will come back and update this with a three star review. I have had better, lesser expensive, less battery hungry models (and like I said, the manual grind work just as well). I give it 4 stars for the 'coolness' factor.

Count on Cole & Mason to give your table salt and pepper grinders a touch of class!
